sources.transform: Two original 32x48 crisp pixel-art frames composed from the project ash, iron, and ember palette.
Reference-only study of silhouette readability, black-space distribution, limb separation, and contrast placement; no source pixels or creature geometry used.

runtimePolicy: The authored SVG is loaded as a presentation-only two-frame billboard. Frame timing is not simulation state or RNG, and the reference pack remains staging/reference-only.
